title: Understanding the Logistic Regression Model
text: The logistic regression model is given by the equation: \( \hat{y}=\sigma(\theta_0+\theta_1x) \). Here, \( \sigma \) is the sigmoid function, which transforms the linear combination of features into a probability.

title: Interpreting the Scale Parameter
text: The scale parameter \( $$\theta_1$$ \) in the logistic regression model affects the steepness of the curve. A larger absolute value of \( $$\theta_1$$ \) results in a steeper curve.

title: Estimating \( $$\theta_1$$ \)
text: To estimate \( $$\theta_1$$ \), consider the change in the log-odds of the response variable \( $$y$$ \) with respect to the feature \( $$x$$ \).

title: Calculating the Log-Odds
text: The log-odds of the response variable \( $$y$$ \) is given by \( \log(\frac{P(y=1|x)}{P(y=0|x)})=\theta_0+\theta_1x \). What is the change in log-odds when \( $$x$$ \) changes by $$1$$ unit?

title: Finding the Closest Value
text: Given the options $$\(-100\)$$, $$\(-1\)$$, \(1\), and \(100\), which value is closest to the estimated \( $$\theta_1$$ \)?
